units: <cite ref="Mishnah Berakhot 1:5">Ber. I, 5</cite> <he>עד שדְּרָשָׁהּ בן זומא</he> until Ben Zoma found an intimation of it in the Biblical wording.
<cite ref="Taanit 5b:9">Taan. 5ᵇ</cite> <he>מקרא אני דוֹרֵשׁ</he> I find it intimated in a Bible verse.
<cite ref="Bava Metzia 104a:8">B. Mets. 104ᵃ</cite> <he>היה ד׳ לשון הדיוט</he> interpreted the popular (Chaldaic) wording used in documents.
<cite ref="Pesachim 22b:10">Pes. 22ᵇ</cite>, v. <cite ref="A03395"><he>אֵת</he></cite>; a. v. fr.—Part. pass. <he>דָּרוּשׁ</he>, f. <cite ref="D01077"><he>דְּרוּשָׁה</he></cite>.

<cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Yevamot 8:1:5">Y. Yeb. VIII, 8ᵈ</cite> top <he>והלא ד׳ הוא</he> has not the word <he>ממנו</he> been employed for interpretation?, opp. <he>מופנה</he>.—Denom. <cite ref="D01093"><he>דְּרִישָׁה</he></cite>, <cite ref="M00337"><he>מִדְרָשׁ</he></cite>.
<cite ref="Mishnah Chagigah 2:1">Ḥag. II, 1</cite> <he>אין דּוֹרְשִׁין ב־</he> you must not lecture on &c.
Snh. 99ᵇ ודורש בהגדות וכ׳ lectured on topics with the object of fault-finding; a. v. fr.—דּוֹרֵשׁ lecturer.
<cite ref="Shemot Rabbah 42:3">Ex. R. s. 42</cite>, beg. <he>אבא הַדֹּ׳</he> Abba, the lecturer.
<cite ref="Shemot Rabbah 8">Ex. R. s. 8</cite>, end, v. <cite ref="A02003"><he>אֲמוֹרָא</he></cite>.—Pl. <he>דּוֹרְשִׁים</he>.

<cite ref="Sanhedrin 38b:22">Snh. 38ᵇ</cite>; <cite ref="Avodah Zarah 5a:9">Ab. Zar. 5ᵃ</cite> <he>דור דור ודוֹרְשָׁיו</he> every generation with its preachers. <he>דּוֹרְשֵׁי חמורות</he>, v. <cite ref="H00390"><he>חוֹמֶר</he></cite>; <he>ד׳ רשומות</he>, v. <he>רְשׁוּמָה</he>. [<cite ref="Mishnah Moed Katan 2:5">M. Kat. II, 5</cite> (<cite ref="Moed Katan 13b:6">13ᵇ</cite>) <he>דורשין</he> Ms. M. (ed. <he>עושין</he>), read <he>דּוֹשְׁשִׁין</he>.]

senses.gloss: to be interpreted, expounded. Sifra, introd. rules שהתורה נִדְרֶשֶׁת בהן by which the Law is interpreted. Y. Peah II, 17ᵃ דברים הַנִּדְרָשִׁין מן הכתב things which are derived by interpretation from the written code (Torah); הנדרשין מן הפה derived from the oral code (Mishnah). Y. Meg. I, 70ᵃ top נתנה להִידָּרֵשׁ is a legitimate object of interpretation.
same. Y. Keth. III, 27ᵈ top מִתְדָּרֵשׁ (מִתְדָּרְשָׁה) ולו וכ׳ the words v’lo &c. are open for interpretation, v. גְּזֵרָה.
